#2524. Aspect analysis: Leipzig never found a trigger – LC

von Next Generation am 20.10.2026 in den Kategorien Uncategorized mit 0 Kommentaren

A 6-1 reads like a game in which everything fell apart. Look at how the goals came about one by one and a different picture emerges: it was not six separate problems but two or three, which Bayern punished in seven variations. No pressure on the man in possession, marking problems in central areas, and a back line that did not work with the movements in front of it – that chain runs through practically every goal conceded.

This aspect analysis therefore takes the goals rather than the game as its material and works back from there to the patterns.

Bayern triggered very high throughout, stayed tight to their opponents and pushed through centrally without hesitation. Vandevoordt was pressed from Bayern’s right, with the clear intention of keeping him away from the left-hand build-up route and forcing the long ball. Leipzig’s front line of Nusa and Brajan Gruda repeatedly angled their runs deep against Nathaniel Brown and Konrad Laimer.

Bayern had one extra central player dropping into midfield in this phase, usually Kimmich. Had Leipzig played short to the right, he could have pressed through onto Raum; in practice he stayed central and pushed through from there. That left Leipzig with the long ball, and it was ineffective: it produced almost no regains, so the enforced forward play brought neither relief nor territory.

Going the other way, Leipzig got no access at all, and the reason was Bayern’s rotations. Kimmich dropped right, Pavlović left into a back three, with Upamecano holding a very wide position. Against this shifting three-man build-up Leipzig never found a trigger, because the assignments reset with every rotation – whoever was supposed to step out of midfield first had to work out who he was picking up. The handover of pressing duties out of central areas failed repeatedly.

In front of that, Bayern staggered their shape so that Leipzig’s compactness became the problem. Olise moved into the ten space at times, Nathaniel Brown operated in the half-lane and ran beyond from there, Luis Díaz stayed wide left. Saibari and Kane pinned several opponents centrally while regularly pulling out of the central lane. Because Leipzig pressed very narrow, this produced exactly what Bayern were looking for: once the opponent was committed near the ball, the switch followed, and on the now open side stood a one-on-one.

That already builds the bridge to the goals. The isolated one-on-ones in which Luis Díaz got his three finishes were not individual moments but the product of this sequence of pinning and switching.

1-0, Luis Díaz (12.) – The first goal already contains the full diagnosis. Kimmich receives centrally without any pressure and can turn out with an open body shape. Ahead of him Saibari and Kane occupy the central zone in front of the box, which forces Orban and Lukeba to step out – so far, the intended part. The full-backs, however, do not push up with that movement and stay too deep, while Raum’s position plays the runner onside. Klostermann stays outside and leaves the inside lane unsecured, and that is exactly where Luis Díaz starts from. Out of that unprotected lane Díaz runs into the back line and Kimmich chips the ball in behind. Not one bad decision, but four players whose decisions did not fit together.

2-0, Aleksandar Pavlović (26.) – Same cause, different route. Kane drops deep and Leipzig do not shift across as a unit – the reactions showed it clearly: arms thrown up, gesturing, hands dropping again, the beginnings of frustration. Kane gets the free body shape, and with him the consequence is predictable: the long ball, high or flat. Because Leipzig are so narrow centrally, the ball flies straight through the entire zone in front of their back line. Luis Díaz moves actively into the passing lane to control it while Klostermann tries to get into his running line and does not make it – Díaz reaches the ball first. From the one-on-one he wins, Díaz dribbles centrally at Orban, which creates a four-against-three on the break. Díaz pins Orban and Lukeba centrally, Pavlović overlaps on the left after holding a high, left-leaning position all evening and threatening the back line. Two touches, left foot, finished away from the defender.

3-0, Michael Olise (34.) – Here Bayern’s press shows itself at its clearest. From a Leipzig throw-in, the man-orientation is fully visible: consistent pushing through, clean handovers. A misplaced pass from Raum then cannot be defended, because neither the tracking nor the duelling is good enough to disturb the pass. Kane can open up half-way. Centrally, Olise comes inside from the wing, and Banzuzi and his partner fail to pick him up, letting him run through – against a player of that variability, an invitation to the key pass. Luis Díaz runs beyond and drags Orban with him, Klostermann is pinned wide by Saibari and can no longer get back into central areas. Olise finishes against the goalkeeper’s movement, across his standing leg into the far corner, catching Vandevoordt completely on the wrong foot.

4-0, Luis Díaz (47.) – After a regain, Bayern switch quickly to the far side and once diagonally through, putting Díaz in a one-on-one again. He holds the ball in the dribble, and Leipzig fail to solve the situation in three steps: the centre is not closed, Orban is too late stepping out, Klostermann does not get into the duel. That Vandevoordt leaves the far corner open is the final piece of an isolated one-on-one that should never have arisen.

5-0, Harry Kane (53.) – Structurally the most interesting goal. Leipzig play a long ball without preparing it and react to the consequences contradictorily: the back line does not push up at all, while the midfield line and both forwards counterpress forwards. The ten space opens up enormously, the gaps between the lines become huge – and Olise is standing in that zone. One pass from Kim is enough to take six Leipzig players out of the game. Olise runs unopposed at the back line and lays it off to Díaz, who is in a one-on-one again; Brown joins for the two-against-one and shifts into the inside lane. Klostermann does not pick up his run from the deep half-space, and centrally Kane again drops into Orban’s blind side – a pattern that stood out across the whole game. The result is a two-against-one against the goalkeeper.

6-0, Luis Díaz (69.) – From a set piece Bayern create a five-against-four out wide. Gnabry pins opponents and makes the space for Díaz, Orban again takes one big step in the block and does not get into the duel. The same scene as the 4-0, only from a different phase of play – a sign that this is a behavioural pattern rather than a snapshot.

6-1, Andrija Maksimović (90.+1) – Leipzig’s goal shows in reverse what their own game had been missing. Bayern drop into a deeper block here, and Leipzig combine centrally before going wide. Gruda gets into a one-on-one against Brown, Upamecano steps across – but from above, with too wide a gap and without closing the centre. That opens the one-two, which Leipzig take immediately. Because the whole situation narrows onto that combination, the space behind it stays unoccupied, and Maksimović can take two touches on his left and finish unopposed.

The sequence of goals reads like a repetition. Five of Bayern’s six come from the same combination of no pressure on the ball centrally and a back line that does not manage the space behind it. Luis Díaz stands in an isolated one-on-one three times, Orban is twice too late with a step that is too big, Kane repeatedly drops into his blind side. Klostermann certainly did not have his best day – but it would be too easy to settle the bill with him. In the decisive scenes he faced situations that functioning protection in front of him should never have allowed to arise in the first place.

Behind it all lies not an individual problem but a structural one: Leipzig pressed narrow and found no trigger against Bayern’s rotating back three. That very compactness made the switch of play the opponent’s most effective tool, and at the end of every switch stood a one-on-one that Leipzig lost. The scoreline is not the story – the story is that the same scene worked six times.

LC is often found in a classroom, happiest on a football pitch, and occasionally on LinkedIn.

#2522. Could Nwaneri's lack of playing time prompt Arsenal to end Dortmund loan early?

After joining Borussia Dortmund on a season-long loan deal just before the summer transfer window closed, Ethan Nwaneri was initially handed decent playing time and started four consecutive Bundesliga games between Matchdays 3 and 6.

However, the 19-year-old's playing time has decreased significantly as the season progressed, and he has played just 47 minutes across five short cameos in BVB's last six games in all competitions.

The lack of playing time is hardly ideal for Dortmund or Nwaneri himself, but it is arguably an even bigger concern for Arsenal, who sent him out on loan specifically to find regular first-team football.

Nwaneri found himself in a similar situation during the second half of last season, when he was on loan at Olympique Marseille. He made just four starts in 11 appearances and was left on the bench for his final four Ligue 1 games

With the Gunners certainly keen to avoid a repeat of that scenario, they could potentially activate the recall clause reportedly included in their agreement with Dortmund, unless Nwaneri's situation improves in the coming weeks.

German outlet Ruhr Nachrichten previously reported that, should Arsenal wish to exercise the clause, they must make their intentions clear "well before the start of the transfer window". Exactly how far in advance they need to do so, however, is unclear.

#2521. Conferenza Rrahmani: “Siamo sempre stati con Allegri”

Le parole del difensore azzurro dopo l'1-1 contro la Lazio: l'analisi della rimonta e la compattezza dello spogliatoio.

Nella conferenza post-partita seguita al pareggio per 1-1 tra Napoli e Lazio, Amir Rrahmani ha tracciato un bilancio lucido della prestazione degli azzurri e del momento della stagione.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

Primo tempo con tante difficoltà, la Lazio aveva spazio per le nostre palle perse. Nel secondo tempo abbiamo dominato e potevamo anche vincere. È andata così, ma abbiamo dato tutto in campo e sono orgoglioso di questo. Abbiamo giocato bene per tutto il secondo tempo, la Lazio è prima in classifica e ha una grande pazienza nel modo di giocare. Aspetta il momento giusto per attaccare, difende e riparte. Nel secondo tempo non penso siano stati solo venti minuti buoni, ma tutta la seconda frazione.

Siamo sempre stati con Allegri, ha vinto tutto in carriera e crediamo in lui. Possiamo uscire da questa situazione, sono qui da anni e ho vissuto di tutto. Ma siamo ancora in tutte le competizioni e possiamo giocarci ogni cosa, dobbiamo dare tutto è crederci. Abbiamo avuto tanti infortuni con nove partite in un mese, ma siamo riusciti a finire queste gare non benissimo pur provandoci e dando tutto. Ora dobbiamo ripartire da questo secondo tempo che ha mostrato che possiamo fare di più. Quando non prendiamo gol dico sempre che il merito è della squadra e della pressione portata. Dipendono da questo, non solo dalla difesa, i gol subiti finora. Si inizia dall’attacco. Ma stiamo migliorando dopo aver subito tanto, che non è da noi. Lavoriamo per migliorare, tanti giocatori torneranno e speriamo di non perderne altri.

#2520. Access, Not Chances: How Como Took Manchester United Apart – LC

von Next Generation am 24.10.2026 in den Kategorien Champions League,Uncategorized mit 0 Kommentaren

Como beat Manchester United 4-1 — and in this case the scoreline really is a fair expression of the game. For long stretches the match was one-sided, not in terms of chance volume but in terms of access: Como dictated in every phase where the ball went, who received it, and under what conditions it had to be played on. United never got on terms in any of those phases.

Cesc Fàbregas’s side showed two things that rarely go together. Out of possession, a pressing structure with clear direction, isolation of one side, and man-marking that applied near the ball only for the action in progress while everything around it was already speculating on the second ball. And in possession, a positional game of remarkable technical maturity that ties opponents in, switches play, and works systematically into the space behind them. The 4-1 is therefore less an outlier than evidence of work that has been built up over recent seasons.

This analysis goes through the phases one by one: first Como in possession and United’s response, then the work against the ball from the high press to defending the box, and finally the goals.

In build-up, Como moved away from their nominal 4-2-3-1 and sat closer to a 4-3-3, with the eights as the real variable: very free in their movement and above all active in the half-spaces. The base structure stayed stable — a flat four plus a six in front of them, sometimes ahead of the line, sometimes slightly behind the forward line.

Close to their own goal, Como consistently involved goalkeeper Butez as an additional central player in the build-up. That created a five-against-four against United’s front line — awkward on paper, more awkward still in execution, because Como didn’t use the overload to play through but to tie opponents in. From there, the same shape kept appearing on both the right and the left: centre-back, full-back, a player from the half-position in the eight space, and a six alongside. A diamond that wasn’t an end in itself but had a purpose: the diagonal route out.

Como’s build-up structure. From a 4-1 (flat four), the half-positions with Paz and Perrone are added. Small triangles and diamonds emerge. The three attackers ahead of them create additional options in behind.

One detail deserves particular attention. At times the full-backs stood not wide but flat, in a half-position. That sounds like a nuance, but it had a clear function: it vacated the wing and created the space the eights could drop into — Paz and Perrone did so regularly. If you don’t occupy the wing yourself, you force the opponent to guard it anyway.

ManU got no access near the ball and left large diagonal spaces open on the far side.

For United’s midfielders this was close to unsolvable. Tielemans, Mount and Andrey Santos spent the whole game struggling to establish any responsibility at all, let alone get into duels. When an eight dropped out, they couldn’t follow, and if one of them was tied in by it, a two-against-one opened up on the far wing. Como didn’t create that situation once; they created it serially.

The decisive mechanism lay in receiving and relaying the ball. The player in the deeper position usually worked with two touches: the first took the ball backwards, the second relayed it to the free teammate. At the end of every one of those actions stood a player with the game in front of him — and from that open position he could switch play.

What made it possible were the preparatory movements. Paz and captain Da Cunha first lured their markers in the wrong direction and then worked with the head start they’d bought. That head start isn’t only space, it’s above all time: time to control the ball first and relay it second, rather than having to do both in one touch.

A scene in the 17th minute is typical. Mason Mount steps out, Mazraoui goes into the duel at the same time — nominally United are in an overload here. Only neither of them really gets to the opponent, because both are too late. Paz can therefore calmly take his touch backwards and switch play directly with the second, dissolving the pressure before it had even formed.

When the build-up ran down the right, it showed in a recurring pattern: Paz and Da Cunha took the first touch backwards or inside and then switched with the left foot out of a closed body position. The players they found were systematically in open positions — Milla, the far-side six, or the wing-to-wing connection directly.

In the second half, Como adjusted the shape and more often played with two sixes, to form the diamonds faster and switch to the far-side six faster. Couto stood out in this: the right-back repeatedly played the chip into the six or ten space — six or seven times in a row during one spell. It was mainly Paz who received the ball there and could launch the attack.

In the second half Como focus on those diagonal spaces and look for them mainly with chipped balls.

Especially striking inside the diamond are the rotations between the players. Because of the connections between them, they moved in rotation depending on running path, space and ball movement. The same recurring spaces were re-occupied. Under pressure on the ball carrier, the outer players pushed flat or ran in behind the opponents; the highest player in the diamond burst out of the cover shadow and became the reference point in depth. On a deep pass, the two wide players released and joined the depth, able to offer themselves again immediately in an open body position. If the pass went via the flat wide players, the spaces in front of the new ball carrier could be run into. Every rotation, every positional adjustment was coordinated with the others and, in the end, produced a stream of pressure-resolving passes while Manchester United chased the press in vain.

Como bridged the middle third exceptionally quickly, via dribbles at speed and diagonal passes. Behind it stood a recognisable principle: first tie the opponent to one wing, then get behind them via the diagonal, and in the final third do the same thing again. In sum, that produced the shape of a Z — build-up on the right, transition on the left, finish from the right again.

In this example Como pin ManU in the press with their short passing. Thanks to the extra attacker on the ball-near side they can play through the pressure and switch.

The connections between wingers and striker carried these attacks and were deliberately kept flexible. The wide players sometimes stayed wide, sometimes came short, sometimes tucked inside. Douvikas accordingly either waited deep in front of the line for the chipped ball or, when space opened up on the wing, received the deeper pass and then ran in behind along the wing as soon as the ball sat on the full-back’s open foot. That flexibility produced the overloads on one side, and the overloads produced the central overload.

In the final third one element was added that is rare in fast transition teams: patience. Como drew opponents towards them with dribbles and short passes, used back-passes when needed, and then switched in front of the block. Da Cunha, Baturina and Paz were the three who could tie opponents in and then find the diagonal. They created the positions on the diagonal, were available to receive, and used their space to apply pressure. The block was usually tied in with short touches, the switch and the position behind the opponent prepared, and quick finishes sought.

The intensity in possession shouldn’t be underestimated. Practically every attack involved at least three or four players, the width was occupied, the centre likewise, and there were multiple options throughout. What they looked for almost every time was the space behind the opponent on the far side — exactly the zone that is closed last when a block shifts across.

Paz brought the right profile for this pattern. A strong left foot cutting inside from the right, he repeatedly dropped into the right-hand blind side of his opponents, got shots away there with few touches, and racked up the most shots of the match. That the finishes generally came off few touches isn’t a detail but the consequence of the time won further back.

As the move continues, Como again look for the blind side of the defenders. Here Douvikas and Paz are positioned in behind, with Da Cunha joining in front of the back line. After briefly pinning the opponents, the switch reaches Da Cunha, who misses the target from distance.

What carries all of this is the technical execution. Soft passes, sharp ones when the moment called for it, consistently well timed and played into the right foot — for ninety minutes. Passing that secure at that tempo is what makes a variable concept actually retrievable.

United’s basic problem out of possession was the hybrid. They pressed half man-oriented, but with a plus-one in the last line — a construction that forces compromises in both directions. It demands access up front that it doesn’t fund at the back.

There were certainly moments when it worked. When Dalot pushed through into the press on the right and passed his man backwards, a clean man-orientation emerged all the way up to the front — and with it a clear assignment for Mount, out of which the ball could be won. But that stayed the exception. Most of the time Dalot sat too flat out of possession, so United couldn’t trigger the duels up front and went into the press a man short.

Mount was the most conspicuous case in this respect. He barely got into a duel across the whole match because the decision to step out always came too late. Against a team that works with preparatory movements, a late decision is practically the same as none: the opponent already has the head start before the journey even begins.

On top of that came a problem on the far side. There, United’s winger frequently failed to protect the depth — usually Mbeumo, who jogged back rather than closing the space. But that was precisely the target zone of Como’s diagonal switches. It allowed them to change sides almost at will and regularly find an open structure on the other side.

The second half brought no improvement. The distances to opponents stayed large, and centrally what was actually intended still didn’t materialise. Michael Carrick’s double change at half-time was meant to bring more physicality to the six with Carlos Baleba, but it didn’t solve the problem — the assignments still didn’t work, the duels in the centre still didn’t happen, and the wide positions dragged the eights out further, which opened new spaces.

In the end the energy simply wasn’t there to press with the necessary intensity. United’s press became increasingly static, and a static press against an opponent with this passing quality yields not a single ball win — it only hands them the starting positions they’re looking for anyway.

Como started the game in a high press and sustained it above all in the first half, with isolated spells after the break too. It was triggered on back-passes and goal kicks — and, remarkably, by their own goals: after every strike the team immediately pushed high again instead of managing the lead in a deeper block.

The steering ran consistently towards United’s left build-up side. The reason is personnel: Harry Maguire played there with his weaker left foot as the outside foot, and next to him stood another right-footer in Noussair Mazraoui on the left. Two right-footers on one build-up side means the ball always has to be taken back inside to play on — exactly where Como were closing the door. The press was usually triggered by the left-sided forward, with the ball ending up at either Maguire or Mazraoui.

Pressing structure after the change in the second half.

In the centre Como defended man-oriented, with both sixes pushing very high and taking flat passes into United’s midfielders out of the game. That removed the short route through the middle as an option and left the long ball. But the long ball triggered nothing for United: the second balls went to Como practically every time.

That isn’t chance, it’s running work. The sixes consistently tracked the negative pressing paths back, anticipated the long ball early, and were in front of the line before it arrived. Luis Milla covered the most ground of any player on the pitch in this pattern — recovery runs after being played past, doubling up on the ball, attacking the second ball. When the long ball came from Maguire or one of the full-backs, a six was regularly in front of the line with an intense sprint, sealing the centre, taking away the diagonal follow-up passes and attacking the loose balls.

Defending the long ball and extra support on the second ball.

Once the ball was on one side, that side was isolated. The near-side forward had access to the centre-back and dropped back a touch when the pass went to the full-back, so that he covered centre-back and six simultaneously and closed the square pass. The far-side forward marked the goalkeeper. That served two functions at once: it took away United’s escape route via the keeper along with the switch, and it kept a player in position for the moment of the turnover.

The double pivot worked in a deliberate half-position. The near-side six stayed tight to his man, the far-side one dropped slightly behind him — securing the space and at the same time establishing access to the far-side centre-back in United’s back three.

The last line defended largely man-for-man in the high press, and very tightly. But the decisive detail is the one that carries the whole concept: the man-marking near the ball applied only to the action in progress. Around it, players were already releasing from their assignments and orienting towards the second ball. That is only retrievable at very high intensity — and it’s the reason United’s forced long balls produced not a single usable moment.

When Como dropped a line, the man-orientation at the second height stayed exceptionally high. Here too the back-pass served as the trigger to push up as a unit and tip back into man-marking. If United were in a closed body position, the Comaschi had already pushed up far enough to attack the back-pass at the moment it was played — a pattern that led directly to the 3-0. The half-position was at work there again: closing down level with the centre-back while simultaneously prepared to push through onto the next player deeper.

In the first half Como still had problems assigning the half-positions against ManU’s 3-2-5. In this example Fernandes moves to the wing, Como fail to establish responsibility and access and are played through at mid-height.

Up to half-time, though, Como had a structural problem with this. The pure man-marking didn’t come off cleanly, because of the two sixes in front of the line, one should really have tucked in and taken over the half-position for the centre-backs. That didn’t happen consistently. The consequence: a centre-back stepped out, the space behind him stayed unoccupied, and that was exactly what United kept attacking.

The pattern of pressing onto Manchester United’s left side continued in the second half, now with Dalot at full-back. The press was still triggered by Douvikas, with the ball-near winger pushing up as a second striker to press the centre-back. Paz focused on the visitors’ ball-near six and Couto pushed through onto Dalot. Through the central connections the game was isolated on one side.

At half-time Como adjusted. One six moved directly into the line, with the far-side winger pushing in onto the six — they now pressed out of a 5-2-1-2. Lucas Da Cunha pressed through from the right onto Maguire, while Nico Paz picked up United’s six. The central forward pressed the central centre-back and from there carried on to the goalkeeper. The far-side wide midfielder and the remaining six were poised — one onto United’s free six, one onto the far-side centre-back — again in that half-position between opponent and the space to be protected.

ManU building up high against the man-oriented Italians.

The effect was immediately visible. Como controlled the half-positions, got access right into the last line throughout, and set the rhythm of the match from then on. The adjustment solved exactly the problem the first half had left open, without changing the underlying principle.

In the final phase Como defended from a very deep line inside the box. That left barely any space behind the line to play into — which United hardly looked for anyway. The visitors attacked little depth and rarely occupied the width in the final third, so Como could stay compact without being punished for it.

Accordingly, a lot of players stood very centrally in and in front of the box. That produced numerous cover shadows and a numerical superiority around the ball, which allowed them to steer actively within the block rather than merely react. At times they deliberately steered inside, to guide the opponent into the prepared congestion and cover from a deeper position.

Deep back line in the box, centre closed and play steered inside. The box defending allowed the English side shots from distance.

The crucial point is that Como left the gaps open not despite this set-up but because of it. If you pack the box and secure the depth, you give up the space in front of the line — and that is exactly where United were supposed to shoot from.

The numbers vindicate the decision. Taking the conceded goal out of the box, Como allowed nine shots from outside the penalty area across ninety minutes, worth roughly 0.24 xG combined; only three of them were even on target. On top of that, of the four shots inside the box, two came from at least 14 to 15 metres and effectively belong in the long-range category as well. United accepted the invitation, and the shooting quality was perfectly decent — it’s just that with that scoring probability over a whole match, the most likely outcome is precisely what happened.

1-0, Nico Paz (2′) — The goal comes before United are even set. Como take the goal kick quickly and play straight to the full-back, luring the visitors into the press — only not cleanly. Mason Mount triggers the pressure and is played past, and on the second ball he goes into the duel as well instead of holding the middle and looking for the space where he could pick the ball up. That is exactly what opens the centre, the space for the second ball is there, and Paz can play it through.

What follows is the transition principle in its purest form: a quick switch to the diagonal side, then short passes against a very deep line. Matheus Cunha doesn’t pick up the player behind him and leaves the ten space open, where Paz is standing. He needs two touches because neither Cunha from above nor Maguire from his distance gets into the duel. Lammens, for his part, doesn’t defend the goal with his cover shadow but takes the near post — which leaves the far corner to a strong left foot. The curled finish into it is quality, though.

2-0, Anastasios Douvikas (49′, assist Paz) — Same zone, same cause. Bryan Mbeumo doesn’t choose to shut the centre but closes the centre-back, which creates the space for Da Cunha, who drives forward and plays Martin Baturina in. Centrally, Mount again fails to pick up his man. Out wide, Amad Diallo, introduced at half-time, generates no pressure centrally, so Mazraoui can’t take over the deep wide player in the first place.

The result is Paz behind the opponent, in the ten space, dribbling unopposed at goal. Matthijs de Ligt establishes no reference to Douvikas’s run in behind and slips as well — a one-against-one with the goalkeeper that Douvikas finishes coolly.

3-0, Nico Paz (57′) — The only goal that comes directly out of the work against the ball. Como are in the midfield press in a closed position with access to the inside lane, win the ball there and punish a lapse of concentration in the visitors’ build-up. At the end, Paz is alone in front of Lammens again.

4-0, Jacobo Ramón (76′, assist Kaiki) — This goal comes from a longer possession spell and shows the assignment problem in its clearest form. Mazraoui is too narrow and has no access to the wide player. Diallo stands in the space with access to neither the central player nor the full-back nor the winger — an orientation that doesn’t work in any direction.

Como switch to Máximo Perrone, who can slide the ball out wide because the space is simply free. From there comes the cross from an open body position, and in the centre Como run a two-against-one at the end of which Ramón scores.

4-1, Joshua Zirkzee (90′) — Como’s only lapse, and one in a phase in which the team had already dropped very deep. United get the ball to the wing, it’s two against two in the box, and the cross is initially only feinted. Zirkzee orients himself well forwards at that moment, while Como’s defenders are already stepping out after the feinted cross. Diallo’s ball in behind the line is strong, the offside call is razor-thin in his favour, and Zirkzee takes two touches before finishing one-against-one with the goalkeeper. A blemish, not a structural problem.

The common denominator — Three of Como’s four goals come in the same zone: the space in front of and behind United’s line that nobody takes responsibility for. Mount is involved in two of those scenes through an assignment he never establishes, Diallo in two more after coming on. Nico Paz is at the heart of three of the four goals, twice as scorer, once as the provider — always out of the opponent’s blind side.

Como’s 4-1 has one common cause across every phase, and it lies less in any single idea than in its execution under continuous load. Out of possession they steered, isolated and speculated on the second ball — with man-marking that applied near the ball only for the action in progress and was already dissolved around it. In possession they tied opponents in, switched play and worked systematically into the space behind. Both require eleven players to anticipate a teammate’s decision, and both functioned over the full distance.

The connecting detail is the half-position. In the press, the far-side six stood between opponent and the space to be protected; in possession, the eights worked out of the same zone, and the full-backs occupied it flat in order to vacate the wing for exactly those players. Como, in other words, occupied the position in both directions from which two jobs can be done at once — which is why the side could neither be played past in the press nor be pinned in the build-up.

For United the diagnosis is more uncomfortable than the result. The problem wasn’t individual errors but that the team never, in any phase, got into the duels it needed. The mixture of half man-orientation and a plus-one in the last line funded no access up front, and without access every decision is made too late — from Mount in the centre to Mbeumo failing to secure the far-side depth. Carrick’s double change at half-time was meant to bring physicality to the six with Carlos Baleba, but it changed nothing about the assignments, and in Diallo a player came on wide who reached neither one opponent nor the other in his space. That the energy ran out in the end was a consequence rather than a cause.

That leaves the context. A 4-1 against Manchester United is no proof in itself, and Como’s finishing was exceptionally efficient on the night. What showed regardless of the result, though, is a team with a recognisable, rehearsed answer in all four phases of the game — and one that put a technical maturity on the pitch in possession that you wouldn’t readily credit to a side promoted two years ago.

#2518. Vignes espère grappiller au moins un point

Entraîneur de la plus mauvaise équipe à l'extérieur de Ligue 2 (1 points sur 15), le Lavallois David Vignes (53 ans) s'est exprimé en conférence de presse avant d'affronter demain soir dans le Chaudron des leaders stéphanois intraitables à la maison depuis le début de saison (5 victoires en 5 matches). Extraits.

"Saint-Etienne, Geoffroy Guichard, ça m'évoque beaucoup de souvenirs, même si j'étais très jeune à la fin des années 70. Mais évidemment, tout le monde en parlait. Au début des années 80, c'était le club phare, un peu le PSG d'aujourd'hui, avec d'autres valeurs, avec d'autres moyens. Les Verts, ça a bercé mon enfance. J'ai beaucoup vu d'images, j'ai entendu beaucoup de chansons qui ont aussi dicté mon enfance. Lorsque j'ai démarré le foot à 6 ans, très tôt, j'ai eu un maillot de Saint-Etienne à mettre sur mes épaules aux entraînements. Le fameux Manufrance, Le Coq sportif…

Les Verts, c'est beaucoup de souvenirs, un club mythique de notre patrimoine footballistique. Bon, aujourd'hui, un club se trouvant en Ligue 2… Je n'ai pas les yeux de l'enfant qui rêvait devant ces images. C'est aussi de la fierté de pouvoir mener un club, une équipe à jouer dans ce stade-là, face à cette équipe-là. Avec vraiment l'ambition de leur rendre la tâche difficile, d'aller essayer de prendre quelque chose, au moins un point. D’autant plus que c'est un stade que je n'ai jamais vu de match là-bas. Je l'ai visité, mais vide. Là, je vais voir un match de très près. C'est top !

Les Verts ont remporté tous leurs matches à domicile, on n’a pris qu’un point à l’extérieur ? Quand on présente le match comme ça, il est totalement déséquilibré, évidemment, même si la dernière journée, ils ont perdu, nous, on a gagné. Donc, on leur a pris trois points (sourire). Mais non, c'est une équipe qui, pour l'instant, est leader. Sans l'ombre d'un doute, en fait ! C'est vrai qu'ils ont eu cette défaite avec un très bon match des Guingampais. J'ai vu que le coach de Saint-Etienne a attribué ça à la thèse de l'accident. On va faire en sorte que ce soit peut-être un peu plus qu'un accident. Mais on sait que ça va être très, très difficile.

Nous, c'est vrai qu'on n'a pas pris de points à l'extérieur encore. Enfin si, un à Metz tout de même. Mais on a fait cependant des matchs très cohérents à l'extérieur. Et dans la dynamique des récents matchs, j'ai bon espoir qu'on obtienne quelque chose. En affichant la solidité démontrée au moins sur les deux derniers matchs. Il va falloir qu'on soit très discipliné, très rigoureux tout au long du match. Mais effectivement, sans trop se renier, si on doit leur poser des problèmes, c'est aussi en pouvant utiliser le ballon de la meilleure des manières. Et ça, on a quand même posé des problèmes à plusieurs adversaires. Même à l'extérieur.

Même si l'ambiance sera tout autre, j'espère vraiment que mes joueurs vont faire preuve de grande personnalité pour pouvoir leur poser des problèmes dans notre utilisation du ballon. Parce que c'est une équipe qui l'utilise bien. Ils savent aussi faire le dos rond, ils savent défendre. Mais je pense qu'ils préfèrent avoir le ballon que défendre malgré tout. Il y aura des moments charnières dans ce match qu'il faudra bien négocier. Mais il faudra qu'on soit très bons dans ce que l'on fait, dans ce qu'on essaie de faire avec le ballon. Et j'espère vraiment qu'on pourra le démontrer demain.

Si c’est un match bonus ? Ce qui serait bonus, c'est si on obtenait un résultat. Parce que peu d'équipes ont pris des points contre Saint-Etienne. Dunkerque et Guingamp en ont pris trois. Et Metz en a pris un. Après, pour tous les autres, ça a été difficile. Mais là, je ne le considère pas comme un match de gala ou de bonus. Non, c'est ce que j'ai déjà dit aux joueurs et que je vais répéter en fin de journée. Pour nous, notre premier enjeu, c'est de continuer et de valider cette victoire enfin obtenue contre Boulogne. Ce premier clean sheet. L'enjeu est là, c'est de continuer. Ça tombe sur un déplacement à Geoffroy-Guichard. Evidemment, ce n'est pas chose aisée. Mais est-ce qu'il y a vraiment des matchs plus faciles que d'autres ? Je n'en suis pas certain.

Quand on présente comme ça un déplacement à Saint-Etienne qui presque survole le championnat, ce n'est pas facile. Peu d'équipes ont pris des points aux Verts mais il y en a certaines qui ont réussi. Et le football, encore une fois, permet ça. Et donc, pourquoi pas l'avoir à Saint-Etienne ? En tout cas, mon discours sera là. Encore une fois, avec beaucoup d'humilité. Pas question de se prendre pour d'autres sous prétexte qu'on a gagné contre Boulogne. Pas du tout. Mais je sais qu'on peut leur poser des problèmes. Je sais que ça va être difficile. Ça va être très difficile par moments. Mais tout est possible. Et je veux qu'on y aille avec cette ambition-là. Mais ce n'est pas le match de gala, le match bonus. Pas du tout.

Moi, j'aimerais qu'on continue et qu'on enchaîne après cette victoire contre Boulogne, acquise dans la difficulté malgré tout. Mais si on peut aller prendre au moins un point dans la difficulté à Saint-Etienne, ça ne fera que renforcer notre dynamique. Et là, je vois une simple victoire contre Boulogne, tout ce que ça peut amener, engendrer comme soulagement, comme bien-être, même si avant ça, malgré les défaites, l'ambiance était bonne, le travail était bien, le climat, tout était positif. Mais là, on voit de suite qu'une seule victoire, même difficilement acquise, ça nous fait sauter deux places déjà. Et on veut continuer là-dessus."

#2517. Matri racconta depressione e paure al Milan: «Pensavo di avere la Sla»

Prima di esibirsi a Ballando con le stelle, l’ex attaccante ha parlato dell’analisi e del sostegno della famiglia.

Secondo quanto riportato da Ilfattoquotidiano, Alessandro Matri ha raccontato le paure per la propria salute e il periodo di depressione da ipocondria vissuto dopo il ritorno al Milan. Lo ha fatto nella clip trasmessa prima della sua esibizione nella sesta puntata di Ballando con le stelle, programma in cui l’ex calciatore è in gara. A riportare le sue parole è Il Fatto Quotidiano.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

Matri ha ripercorso il passaggio dai successi con la Juventus, dove segnò 30 gol in due anni e mezzo, alle difficoltà incontrate in rossonero. Ha descritto la fine di quella fase come il crollo che può seguire un grande amore e ha spiegato quanto pesasse, per lui, l’esperienza al Milan.

«Ho iniziato a vivere male, mi chiudevo in casa la sera. Ho vissuto il fallimento al Milan come un lutto, mi sentivo un peso», ha detto l’ex attaccante. Nel corso della carriera, Matri ha realizzato 158 reti complessive nei campionati disputati.

Secondo il suo racconto, dalle difficoltà al Milan iniziò quello che ha definito un calvario calcistico: perse autostima e fiducia e si sentì vulnerabile. «Sono caduto in un percorso di depressione da ipocondria. Pensavo di avere la Sla, pensavo di avere la sclerosi multipla», ha spiegato.

In rossonero segnò una rete in 15 presenze in Serie A, 18 considerando tutte le partite. Prima di attirare l’attenzione di diversi grandi club italiani, al Cagliari aveva realizzato 24 gol in due anni. Matri ha ricordato anche quanto fosse difficile parlare delle proprie paure: a suo avviso, un calciatore può sentirsi un supereroe agli occhi degli altri e temere di confidarsi con allenatore, compagni o presidente.

Matri ha raccontato di essere riuscito a dire a Federica Nargi, oggi sua moglie, e ai propri genitori che aveva paura di avere qualcosa. Sentendosi accudito e protetto, ha iniziato un percorso di analisi e, ha spiegato, è stato progressivamente meglio.

«Ho ancora piccole paure, faccio esami ogni 6 mesi. Convivo con questo, ma meglio. La nascita delle mie figlie mi ha distolto dal problema», ha aggiunto. L’ex attaccante ha così descritto una situazione con cui convive ancora, pur dopo il miglioramento seguito all’analisi.

#2516. "We know him and his talent" – Martínez explains decision to bring Tillman into Leverkusen's starting XI

After starting on the bench in two consecutive games, Malik Tillman was restored to Bayer Leverkusen's starting line-up for Sunday's 2-1 Bundesliga win over 1. FC Köln.

Having been criticised for failing to live up to expectations since his €35 million move from PSV in the summer of 2025, the 24-year-old United States international was handed a rare start and impressed head coach Carles Martínez.

"It wasn't easy for Malik. I know he had to deal with a lot of criticism, but we know him and his talent," Martínez explained at the press conference after the game.

Tillman will now link up with the United States national team for their Concacaf Nations League quarter-final matches against Haiti.

#2515. Saint-Etienne, ça fait plus rêver que les autres équipes

Auteur du but égalisateur des Lavallois contre les Verts à Francis Le Basser lors de la première journée de la saison dernière, le Lavallois Ethan Clavreul (20 ans) se réjouit d'être dans le groupe lavallois qui débarquera demain soir dans le Chaudron, comme il l'a expliqué en conférence de presse.

"La saison passée, j'avais vu à la télé le match à Saint-Etienne. Franchement, c'est beau à voir. Même quand tu regardes leurs matchs, il y a toujours une ambiance, il y a une ferveur, il y a un truc. Après moi, quand je rentre sur le terrain, je fais abstraction des tribunes. Peut-être qu'il y aura du bruit, il y aura du monde. Tant que tu fais un bon match, que tu joues, c'est le principal. Franchement, contre Saint-Etienne à Laval, c'était un sentiment particulier parce que c'est mon premier match, mon premier but. Mais là, ça fait 6 gros mois que je suis dans le monde du foot pro. Je sais ce que c'est les ambiances. Franchement, oui, ça peut être impressionnant au début, mais une fois que l'échauffement commence, je suis dans ma bulle et je ne regarde pas trop autour.

Sportivement, quand on affronte une équipe qui n'a pas lâché un point à domicile, comment arrive-t-on à se dire qu'il y a quelque chose à aller chercher là-bas ? On sait qu'on a des armes, ils ont des faiblesses. Ils ont des armes, on a aussi des faiblesses, comme toute équipe. Après, on l'a bien vu, vendredi dernier contre Boulogne, si on est un peu moins beau, ce n'est pas grave. L'objectif, c'est de gagner des matchs. En vrai, on a des armes qui peuvent les embêter comme eux ont des armes pour nous embêter. Je pense que si on est un peu plus mordants qu'eux, on peut les surprendre là-bas et faire un bon coup dans la tête et au classement aussi.

Je pense que le fait qu’ils aient perdu leur dernier match, ça a dû les piquer. Je pense qu'ils se sont dit que la saison n'était pas finie. Ça fait une petite piqûre de rappel. C'est toujours bien pour toute équipe qui gagne beaucoup de matchs à domicile ou à l'extérieur. Nous, on sait qu'ils ont perdu. On sait qu'ils vont être revanchards pour leur public parce que pour eux, c'est interdit de perdre deux fois d'affilée. Nous, on sait qu'on vient d'avoir une victoire à domicile. Nous, on a envie d'emmener le public avec nous. On les a emmenés un peu à Boulogne. Si on gagne à Saint-Etienne, je pense que contre Montpellier, il y aura un peu plus de monde dans les tribunes et un peu plus de bruit.

Quand je savais que Saint-Etienne était encore dans notre championnat, quand on l'a vu, que nous restions aussi dans ce championnat-là, je me dis que ce match-là, à l'extérieur, il faut que j'y aille. L'année dernière, je ne l'ai pas fait. J'étais dégoûté. Toute ma famille avait fait le déplacement. Quand je les appelle, je dis que je ne suis pas dans le groupe. Ce n'était pas extraordinaire. Donc, cette année, je me suis dit que toute la saison, je vais prendre le match par match. Saint-Etienne, ça fait toujours un peu plus rêver que les autres équipes. Ce n'est pas pour autant que je néglige toutes les autres équipes. C'est que Saint-Etienne, il y a une ferveur, il y a un truc. Personnellement, jouer des matchs avec beaucoup d'ambiance, beaucoup de monde au stade, des gros stades comme ça… Oui, ça fait toujours un petit truc dans sa tête !"

#2514. La Lazio Primavera vince sul campo del Cagliari: Sulejmani decisivo al 90'

Mentre al Maradona, la Lazio di Gennaro Gattuso pareggiava sul campo del Napoli, i giovani biancocelesti di Punzi hanno guadagnato 3 punti fondamentali.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

La Lazio Primavera reduce dalla vittoria contro il Sassuolo nella scorsa giornata va a far visita ad un Cagliari reduce da tre vittorie consecutive considerando tutte le competizioni.

Nel primo tempo la Lazio va a più riprese vicino al vantaggio con il portiere del Cagliari che in più di un'occasione è costretto a metterci i guantoni, ma l'occasione principale è sui piedi di Ferrante, che si vede negare la gioia del gol dalla traversa. Nella ripresa è il portiere del Cagliari, Vincenzo Sarno, a prendersi la scena sfoderando diverse parate di pregevolissima fattura. A rompere la parità ci pensa, però, il subentrato Flavio Sulejmani, che al 90' grazie ad una bella girata in area buca la porta rossoblù e regala i tre punti alla Lazio.

Vittoria importantissima per i biancocelesti che con i tre punti conquistati sul campo del Cagliari si colloca al terzo posto a pari punti con il Bologna a -2 dal secondo posto e -3 dal primato con 3 punti di vantaggio sul settimo posto, che vale l'esclusione dai playoff.

#2512. Hoeneß' Musiala comments spark internal criticism at Bayern

Bayern Munich honorary president Uli Honess caused headlines on Sunday after questioning whether Jamal Musiala will ever rediscover his best form following his neurological diagnosis and recurring injury problems.

“Just imagine if FC Bayern were now to question his contract and say: ‘What he is capable of delivering now is no longer what was stipulated in the contract’,” Hoeneß remarked, among other things, during an appearance on the BR programme “Sonntags-Stammtisch”.

According to local outlet TZ, the 74-year-old's comments have sparked internal frustration at Bayern, with the general feeling being that while his concerns were understandable in terms of substance, the way he chose to express them was unnecessary.

The main source of frustration is that Hoeneß has once again shifted the focus towards Musiala's neurological condition, despite the fact that it has nothing to do with his current absence. Instead, the 23-year-old is recovering from a muscle fibre tear.

After collapsing twice earlier in the season, Musiala has not experienced any further absence seizures in the past two months following an adjustment to his medication. His condition is therefore considered to be well under control.

The report further states that Musiala remains the ultimate game-changer for Bayern coach Vincent Kompany, who has consistently supported and motivated the German international publicly.

If Hoeneß was also trying to motivate Musiala, he certainly went about it in a very different way.

#2508. Briançon prépare sa reconversion

Valeureux et heureux capitaine d'un Pau FC 5e de L2 et restant sur une série de 5 succès consécutifs avant de recevoir ce soir les Canaris 5 semaines avant d'accueillir les Verts, l'ancien défenseur stéphanois Anthony Briançon, qui fêtera ses 32 ans dans 3 semaines, a évoqué en début de semaine sa reconversion sur son compte LinkedIn.

"À la base, j’ai créé un compte LinkedIn parce que c’était un exercice demandé pendant ma formation à l'EM Lyon Business School . Je ne pensais pas forcément que ce réseau aurait un véritable intérêt pour moi. Et puis, en avançant dans ma réflexion sur l’après-carrière, j’ai compris quelque chose : préparer la suite ne commence pas le jour où l’on arrête de jouer.

Aujourd’hui, je suis encore pleinement footballeur. J’ai encore des objectifs, des matchs à jouer et beaucoup de choses à vivre sur les terrains. Mais en parallèle, je me forme au scouting, à la data et au métier de directeur sportif. Et pourquoi pas, à terme, passer aussi mes diplômes d’entraîneur.

Après des années passées dans les vestiaires, sur les terrains et au contact de nombreux entraîneurs, dirigeants et joueurs, forcément, on développe un regard différent sur le football. Être capitaine pendant plusieurs années m’a aussi beaucoup appris sur l’humain, l’écoute et l’importance de faire avancer un groupe ensemble.

On apprend à observer un joueur au-delà de ses qualités techniques, à comprendre sa personnalité, ce qu’il peut apporter humainement à un groupe, mais aussi l’importance du partage, de la transmission et des relations que l’on construit au quotidien. Mais l’expérience du terrain ne suffit pas. C’est justement pour ça que j’ai envie de la compléter aujourd’hui

Par de nouvelles compétences, de nouvelles méthodes et une autre manière d’analyser le jeu. Je ne sais pas encore exactement où cette deuxième partie de carrière me mènera. En revanche, je sais dans quelle direction j’ai envie d’avancer. Et je trouve finalement assez logique de commencer à la construire pendant que je joue encore. La carrière de joueur a une fin. La passion du football, beaucoup moins."

Il risultato tra Inter e Como, valevole per l'11° giornata di Serie A

Il pomeriggio domenicale, nell'ultimo weekend prima della sosta di novembre, si accende con il big match tra Inter e Como, attese a San Siro per l'11° turno di Serie A. Reduci entrambe da un tour de force tra campionato e Champions League, le due formazioni arrivano alla gara dopo due importanti vittorie, la più clamorosa quella che ha visto i lariani imporsi per 9-1 sul Lens. Archiviati gli impegni europei, le due compagini si affrontano in campionato con l'obiettivo di scalare la classifica e accorciare le distanze dalla vetta.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

La vittoria in Champions in casa del Feyenoord ha dato fiducia alla formazione guidata da Chivu che, nonostante le diverse assenze, tra cui Lautaro Martinez, riesce a dominare la gara e a chiudere la prima frazione di gioco in doppio vantaggio, grazie alle reti di Pio Esposito e Thuram. Il Como, dal canto suo, è lontano dalla brillante prestazione offerta contro il Lens e si concede troppi errori. Nonostante qualche spunto individuale, il Como accusa il colpo e non riesce a reagire e a rendersi seriamente pericoloso.

La ripresa è ancora nel segno dall'aggressività e intensità dell'Inter, che sfiora in più di un'occasione la rete del tris prima con Dimarco e Thuram. I guizzi di Nico Paz e Ramon non bastano alla squadra di Fabregas per accorciare le distanze. A San Siro termina 2-0 per i padroni di casa: tre punti pesanti che portano i meneghini a solo un punto dalla Lazio capolista.

#2501. Maza to remain at Leverkusen leaving PSG livid over how talks unfolded

According to Sacha Tavolieri, the Ibrahim Maza situation at Bayer Leverkusen has seemingly taken a new turn behind the scenes.

Even after Paris Saint-Germain, with Luis Campos, returning to the negotiating table, a transfer appears to be out of the question.

The Algerian player’s camp and Leverkusen is said to have ultimately put the decision-makers from the French capital club off the deal.

Accordingly, Maza’s father and Leverkusen wanted to bypass the original framework of the talks and re-establish contact with Paris.

The intention was to communicate through the Stellar agency to “test” whether the Ligue 1 club’s interest in Maza was genuine.

However, this move is said to have displeased Luis Campos. PSG’s sporting adviser is said to have then decided to end the talks.

The approach did not reflect the way Paris wants to handle its transfer business – the Maza deal is definitively off the table for PSG.

Furthermore, Paris is said to have reiterated its position: PSG had never itself made a concrete approach to sign the player.

The club had merely explored making an approach after it emerged that Maza’s father was open in principle to a meeting.

For Ibrahim Maza, the door to Paris therefore appears to have closed for now. However, a future move can't be written off completely.

#2500. Surveillez Houdayer !

Depuis leur écrasant succès (11-1) contre Ecotay-Moingt (R3) il y a un an en Coupe de France, jamais les Verts n'ont été donnés autant favoris avant une rencontre que ce soir contre Laval selon les bookmakers.

Ayant à coeur de se racheter après leur défaite à Guingamp, les leaders stéphanois ont remporté tous leurs matches à domicile cette saison tandis que les antépénultièmes Tango n'ont pris qu'un petit point hors de leurs bases.

Le Stade Lavallois, qui n'a jamais gagné à Geoffroy (mais y a subi 16 défaites et arraché 5 nuls), va débarquer diminué dans le Chaudron car il sera notamment privé de 3 avant-centres (tous blessés) : Corentin Fatou, Trévis Dago et Abou Kanté.

Mais les Mayennais ne seront pas complètement démunis offensivement. L'ASSE devra en particulier se méfier de leur meilleur buteur Mathys Houdayer (21 ans), qui a claqué 4 pions (contre Nantes, le Red Star, Pau et Boulogne).

"Artiste et artificier de ce début de saison tango" dixit Ouest-France il y a 8 jours, il a été désigné 6 fois meilleur joueur lavallois cette saison par l'entraîneur de l'équipe d'en face selon Foot National (seuls le Rémois Yahia Fofana et le Nancéien Ilyes Housni ont recueilli davantage de suffrages).

Passeur décisif lors des 2 matches de barrage contre Rouen en mai dernier, le natif de Laval, qui a prolongé son contrat avec son club formateur jusqu'en 2029, a mis en exergue sa polyvalence il y a 2 mois dans le quotidien régional le plus diffusé de France.

"Un attaquant, ça fonctionne avec la confiance. J’ai celle du coach, des supporters, de mes coéquipiers et de mon premier but contre Nantes. J’aime beaucoup être sur le côté. Mais en début de saison, le coach m’a dit qu’il essaierait de m’utiliser le plus possible en faux n°9, 9, 10. pourquoi pas 8 de temps en temps. En 10, je peux prendre des espaces, avoir des joueurs qui fixent les défenseurs, et me laissent le temps de me retourner. C’est un peu régal pour moi."

#2493. U17 : On Aytone puis on bétonne

Vous avez pu suivre cette rencontre en direct sur notre forum grâce à nos envoyés spéciaux Stéphanois et MachuPicchu42 : les U17 ont battu leurs homologues clermontois sur le plus petit des scores cet après-midi à Aimé-Jacquet.

Lors d'une première période guère emballante, seul l'ailier gauche Naël Dani a mis en danger des Auvergnats un peu plus entreprenants mais bien muselés par la charnière centrale Naoufan Mnemoi - Lucas Dagbo.

Juste après l'heure de jeu, sur une bonne passe du numéro 8 Sabri Sercu, Isaak Saydi a fait une percée supersonique avant de délivrer une passe décisive à Gibril Aytone, entré en jeu dès la 32e minute à la place de Léo Fayolle.

Les Verts ont beaucoup souffert pour conserver leur court mais très précieux avantage. Ils ont heureusement pu compter sur la maladresse des visiteurs, qui ont eu en outre la malchance de trouver la barre transversale d'Andrea Laugier à la 87e minute.

La compo : Laugier - Fayolle (Aytone, 33'), Mnemoi, Dagbo, Bufferne - Diakité (Giangreco, 61'), Sercu, Thibaudat - Seydi, Kimpioka, Dani (Tiambo, 90').

La réaction de David Le Moal : "En première mi-temps, on a eu quelques sorties de balle intéressantes, mais par contre il y a eu un manque de coordination et de connexion entre tous les joueurs de l'équipe. Je trouve qu'on a manqué d'énergie aussi. La seconde mi-temps a été encore plus laborieuse. On n'a fait quasiment que défendre après la pause. On a eu quelques contres sur lesquels on a mal joué les coups. On a beaucoup subi même en étant bien en place derrière. C'est dommage qu'on ait concédé autant d'occasions alors qu'on avait décidé de fermer un peu le jeu. Le résultat est bon, on a gagné. Mais en ce qui concerne le contenu de ce match, il n'y a pas grand chose de positif à retenir. On a décroché une victoire sans prendre de but avec beaucoup de U16 qui ne jouaient pas à leur poste donc ça fait quand même quelques satisfactions."

#2491. Gatti a Coverciano con l’Italia: Francia in arrivo, 32 convocati

Il difensore della Juventus si unirà agli Azzurri prima delle due gare che chiuderanno il girone di Nations League.

Roberto Mancini ha aggiunto Federico Gatti ai convocati dell’Italia per le ultime due giornate del girone di Nations League. Secondo quanto riportato da Corriere dello Sport, Il difensore della Juventus raggiungerà nelle prossime ore il Centro Tecnico Federale di Coverciano. Con il suo ingresso, la lista degli Azzurri sale a 32 giocatori.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

L’Italia affronterà la Francia giovedì 12 novembre allo stadio Giuseppe Meazza di Milano. Domenica 15 novembre giocherà invece contro il Belgio allo stadio Re Baldovino di Bruxelles. Gatti si metterà a disposizione del ct in vista di entrambe le partite.

Nelle ultime due sfide gli Azzurri si giocheranno la vittoria del girone. Sono secondi nel Gruppo 1 della Lega A con sette punti: tre in meno della Francia, prima in classifica, e uno in più del Belgio. Il terzo posto è già assicurato e garantisce all’Italia lo status di testa di serie nel sorteggio delle qualificazioni a Euro 2028.

La chiamata di Gatti è la seconda variazione rispetto all’elenco diffuso giovedì. Sabato Mancini aveva rinunciato a Gianluca Mancini, fermato da un risentimento muscolare, e lo aveva sostituito con Matteo Palma.

Il difensore dell’Udinese, classe 2008, è nato a Berlino ed è cresciuto nelle selezioni giovanili della Germania. Dopo il via libera della Fifa al cambio di nazionalità sportiva, Palma ha ricevuto la sua prima convocazione nella Nazionale maggiore. Nel raduno figurano per la prima volta anche Cassano e Liberali del Como, Lontani del Parma e Cisse del Milan.

#2487. La réserve renverse Le Cannet-Rocheville sous les yeux de Lopez

Sous les yeux de Christian Lopez, qui a donné le coup d'envoi fictif de cette rencontre entre ses deux anciens clubs, la réserve s'est imposée (2-1) ce samedi sur le fil et sur le terrain du Cannet-Rocheville (Alpes Maritimes) grâce à un renversant doublé de Lamine Sonko (photo).

Après un premier quart d'heure plutôt équilibré, l'ASSE a pris l'ascendant mais n'a pas su ouvrir le score malgré deux grosses occasions de son très remuant ailier gauche Etienne Mendy et une tentative de Mamadou Konté sauvée in extremis sur sa ligne par un défenseur.

Sainté a concédé l'ouverture du score à la 56e minute suite à un 6 mètres joué trop vite suivi d'une perte de balle. Les Maralpins ont bien joué le coup sur cette action qui semblait quand même entachée d'une légère faute sur Mamadou Konté.

Boostés par l'apport de leurs entrants, les Verts ont égalisé à la 86e minute sur une ouverture de leur latéral droit Tom Teillol pour Lamine Sonko, qui a résisté au retour de deux défenseurs avant de mettre un petit piqué pour tromper le mal prénommé mais bien nommé Victor Battu.

A la 92e minute, Nathan Kasia a perdu le ballon mais s'est bagarré pour le récupérer et lancer Noah Moulin, dont le centre tendu a été repris victorieusement par le supersub Lamine Sonko. Ce succès permet aux Verts de monter provisoirement à la 2e place du classement, derrière le solide leader Berre.

La compo : Colombet - Teillol, Gueye, Kasia, Lenou - Depalle (Thouilleux, 82'), Rised, Reynaud (Cheikh, 75')- Toty, Konte (Sonko, 68'), Mendy 'Moulin, 68')

La réaction de Sylvain Gibert : "On a su faire la différence à la fin du match mais on aurait mérité de mener au score à la pause car la dernière demi-heure de la première période a été très bonne. On a manqué d'efficacité devant le but, c'est donc notre adversaire qui a ouvert le score. Mais on est reparti de l'avant, on a insisté et au final on a été récompensé. C'est la victoire de tout un groupe, les entrants notamment nous ont apporté l'énergie nécessaire pour renverser ce match. Les joueus étaient venus ici pour gagner et ils se sont donnés les moyens d'y parvenir. Il faut les féliciter pour ça. On est content d'avoir décroché ce succès sous les yeux de Christian Lopez, qui nous a fait l'honneur d'être présent et d'échanger avec nous à la fin du match. C'était top car c'est un joueur que j'ai cité la saison dernière dans mes causeries. Je trouve qu'il représente les valeurs du club, cette capacité à ne jamais renoncer, comme l'illustre son mythique intervention sur Oleg Blokhine contre Kiev."

#2484. Official: Tim Walter relieved of coaching duties at Holstein Kiel

Holstein Kiel have parted ways with Tim Walter with immediate effect, as per the latest report from the Kieler Nachrichten.

The decision made by the club's officials was communicated to him today at 17:00 CET earlier this afternoon.

Sporting director, Olaf Rebbe, had placed great hopes in Walter, who played a crucial role in in avoiding relegation to the 3.Liga last season.

Walter not only achieved this task, but also breathed much-needed new life into the team with a new internal structure.

However, having picked up just a solitary win alongside 5 draws in their opening 11 games, Walter's time is now up.

As the daily reports, despite his team's obvious footballing deficiencies, the coach stuck to his style of play which has backfired.

The 51-year-old stuck to his guns at his previous clubs in VfB Stuttgart, HSV, or Hull either – with a similar outcome in the end.

As it stands, Kiel are currently bottom of the 2. Bundesliga. One name who is favourite to take over is ex-Arminia Bielefeld coach Mitch Kniat.

#2482. Gudmundsson torna sul campo: la Lazio lo testa nell'amichevole di sabato

Dopo lo stop iniziato a settembre per la frattura alla spalla, l'islandese giocherà a porte chiuse contro il Mgarr United.

Gudmundsson tornerà a misurarsi con il campo sabato, nell'amichevole a porte chiuse che la Lazio giocherà contro il Mgarr United, squadra della seconda divisione maltese. Secondo quanto riportato da Il Messaggero, L'islandese è fermo da settembre per una frattura alla spalla e Gattuso avrà l'occasione di testarlo durante la sosta.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

La partita offrirà al tecnico un'occasione per verificare i progressi del jolly islandese. Il suo ritorno sul campo si inserisce nel lavoro previsto a Formello durante la pausa: recuperare gli infortunati, ricaricare le energie e valutare chi si avvicina al rientro.

L'amichevole si svolgerà a porte chiuse. Per Gudmundsson sarà il primo confronto con il campo dopo lo stop iniziato a settembre per l'infortunio alla spalla.

Gattuso conta di recuperare Zaccagni durante la sosta. L'esterno, che ha seguito dalla tribuna la partita di Napoli, è alle prese con una lesione alla coscia: l'obiettivo è riaverlo contro il Lecce o, al più tardi, per la sfida con il Torino.

Le preoccupazioni più immediate riguardano però Sutalo e Tavares. Josip ha lasciato il campo al 33' del primo tempo per uno stiramento al flessore sinistro e non risponderà alla convocazione della Nazionale. Nuno conviveva già da giorni con un affaticamento allo stesso muscolo: Gattuso spera che la sostituzione all'intervallo abbia evitato una lesione.

Il terzino potrebbe raggiungere il Portogallo e tornare poi a Formello dopo gli accertamenti. Il Messaggero riferisce così di una pausa nella quale il lavoro sui recuperi accompagnerà quello della squadra.

#2480. Sainté se reprend

Fessés à Guingamp la semaine passée, les Verts ont su rebondir face à la lanterne rouge lavalloise (2-0).

Ian Cathro avait choisi de laisser Sohaib Naïr, en difficulté au Roudourou, sur le banc au profit de Kévin Pedro. Joao Ferreira reprenait le couloir droit. Pour le reste, le coach écossais revenait à son attaque Breum - Boakye - Ballo - Cardona.

Les Verts attaquaient tambour battant. Boakye puis Ferreira testaient le gardien adverse. Malgré la possession du ballon et quelques situations, les occasions franches étaient rares. Il fallait attendre la fin de la mi-temps pour voir le capitaine stéphanois Julien Le Cardinal propulser sa tête sur la barre transversale sur un corner de Breum. Quelques minutes plus tard, c'est en transition que les Verts allaient frapper. Pedro récupérait un ballon devant sa surface et transmettait à Bernauer dont la passe cassait les lignes pour trouver Breum dans l'axe à 30m. Le Danois décalait Cardona qui ajustait le gardien lavallois (1-0, 45+1)

Les Verts avaient fait le plus dur au meilleur moment et allaient enfoncer le clou en début de deuxième période. En inversant les rôles : Cardona à la passe en centrant, Breum à la conclusion de la tête seul face au but à 3 mètres (2-0, 50e)

A partir de là, les Verts se contentèrent de gérer. Par deux fois, ils eurent l'occasion de tuer le match mais Davitashvili perdait son duel en frappant à côté du but et El Jamali se trouait de façon incompréhensible dans les 6 mètres alors qu'il n'avait plus qu'à conclure.

Pas de regrets toutefois pour les Verts qui profitent des revers de Pau, Montpellier et Reims pour reprendre un peu d'air au classement. Toujours en tête, ils devancent Nancy de 3 points avant de passer par la case Coupe de France.

#2479. Lang e la curva del Napoli: fischi dopo il pareggio con la Lazio

La frattura risale alla trasferta di Porto, quando l’olandese lasciò il campo senza salutare il settore ospiti.

La frattura tra Noa Lang e i tifosi del Napoli è emersa anche durante la partita contro la Lazio al Maradona. Secondo quanto riportato da TuttoMercatoWeb, L’esterno olandese ha cercato il sostegno della curva portandosi le mani alle orecchie, ma ha ricevuto fischi. La tensione potrebbe incidere sul suo futuro: a gennaio potrebbe tornare d’attualità una cessione.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

Il gesto con le mani alle orecchie sembrava rivolto ai sostenitori per chiedere di farsi sentire. La risposta, però, è stata una contestazione. Alla base del rapporto incrinato c’è quanto accaduto a Porto: dopo la sconfitta per 4-1, Lang aveva lasciato il campo senza salutare il settore ospiti.

Da quell’episodio la distanza tra il giocatore e una parte della tifoseria napoletana si è accentuata. Al Maradona, il tentativo dell’olandese di ottenere sostegno non ha cambiato il clima nei suoi confronti.

Sul campo Lang è stato tra i giocatori più vivaci del Napoli. Ha cercato l’uno contro uno, ha messo in difficoltà la Lazio e ha servito il cross da cui è nata l’autorete di Pedraza, valsa il pareggio azzurro.

Mentre i compagni festeggiavano, il classe ’99 ha indicato di nuovo l’orecchio alla Curva A. La contestazione è ripresa proprio durante una partita in cui la squadra di Allegri avrebbe avuto bisogno di compattezza. Al termine del match Lang è stato il primo ad abbandonare il terreno di gioco, accompagnato dal coro rivolto a lui: «Lang tu sei un figlio di pu…».

#2476. PSV hold on to book narrow Champions League win in Porto

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results

PSV survived a second-half onslaught in Porto to secure their first win of the Champions League group stages.

Guus Til scored the only goal when he tapped in from close range after Esmir Bajraktarevic’s shot had come back off the post and was steered across goal by Sven Mijnans.

The Eindhoven club were worth their narrow lead against Francesco Farioli’s side after dominating possession in the first half, but rarely troubled Diogo Costa in the Porto goal.

Til went close with a header early in the second half before putting PSV ahead in the 57th minute.

But the visitors had to defend heroically as Porto poured forward in search of an equaliser, aided by an increasingly fragile Matej Kovar.

The goalkeeper put his defenders in jeopardy with a weak clearance in the 72nd minute, but redeemed himself by saving Victor Froholdt’s shot with his chest before Lutsarel Geertruida blocked the follow-up from Pepê.

A minute later Kovar was left stranded after he rushed out of his penalty area, but Sergiño Dest managed to hack the ball away before Alberto Costa could poke it into the open goal.

At the other end, substitute Denis Man came close to scoring a second for PSV with his first touch when his curling shot beat Costa but failed to sneak inside the post.

The 1-0 win lifts PSV to a provisional 16th place in the Champions League table at the halfway stage of round three, while Porto are still looking for their first point.

Their next match is at home to Belgian side Club Brugge, who will make the short trip to Eindhoven on November 4.

#2474. Contribute to help victims of the Pedrógão Grande tragedy

Forest fires occur every summer in Portugal but the tragedy that struck the community of Pedrógão Grande in the centre of the country is unprecedented. Over 60 people lost their lives, many trapped in their cars when trying to flee from the flames.

This Just Giving page is a simple way for people, wherever they are in the world, to make a contribution to help rebuild these communities and bring some comfort to those who lost everything in the blink of an eye. The money raised will be sent to a network of local authorities and charities working in the area affected. Thank you for your support.

#2473. Tavares, Gattuso: «Poteva anche non giocare». Lazio, flessore da valutare

Il portoghese si era allenato poco prima della trasferta di Napoli e ha lasciato il campo all’intervallo.

La Lazio torna da Napoli con un punto e due problemi muscolari da valutare. Secondo quanto riportato da Il Corriere dello Sport, Tavares è stato sostituito all’intervallo per un fastidio al flessore; Sutalo aveva lasciato il campo già nel primo tempo. Per entrambi si ipotizza uno stiramento, ma le rispettive condizioni devono ancora essere accertate.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

Il terzino portoghese era arrivato alla partita in condizioni precarie. Gattuso ha sottolineato la sua disponibilità: «Poteva anche non giocare». Tavares si era allenato poco e aveva una contrattura al flessore, ma ha stretto i denti fino all’intervallo.

Durante la sosta potrebbe comunque rispondere alla convocazione della sua nazionale, anche per sottoporsi a una visita. Diversa la situazione di Sutalo: il difensore ha avvertito una fitta nella prima frazione ed è uscito subito. Gattuso ha spiegato che non andrà in nazionale e che resta da stabilire il grado della lesione. Il Corriere dello Sport riferisce che la pausa permetterà alla Lazio di valutare i due infortuni e di lavorare al recupero degli altri giocatori indisponibili.

Anche Zaccagni sarà sottoposto a un controllo. Il capitano, presente a Napoli al seguito della squadra nonostante l’infortunio, dovrebbe effettuare una risonanza il giorno successivo alla partita o mercoledì. L’esame servirà a chiarire se l’edema dipenda dal trauma subito contro il Cagliari oppure da uno strappo muscolare, eventualità che allungherebbe i tempi di recupero.

Per Gudmundsson, fermo da 45 giorni a causa del problema alla spalla rimediato in nazionale, l’obiettivo è il test di sabato contro il Mgarr United. Potrebbe essere l’occasione per tornare a giocare qualche minuto. Le sue condizioni saranno valutate giorno per giorno: Gattuso spera di riaverlo presto in gruppo, come già accaduto con Rovella e Marusic. Entrambi erano in panchina al Maradona, ma non sono entrati.

#2471. Heidenheim shot-stopper Dähne suffers fractured finger against Hannover 96

Thomas Dähne, 1.FC Heidenheim's goalkeeper, suffered a serious injury during yesterday's home game against Hannover 96.

As confirmed by the Baden-Württemberg based club this evening, Dähne will be out of action for several weeks as he recovers.

Further medical examinations on Monday revealed that the 32-year-old suffered a fracture of the proximal phalanx of his right little finger.

Dähne will therefore undergo surgery. This means the goalkeeper will be unavailable to Heidenheim for several weeks.

The 32-year-old has been in fine form up until now, featuring 9 times and keeping 3 clean sheets as Heidenheim sit in seventh place.

Heidenheim's remaining fixtures for 2026 include SV Darmstadt 98, 1.FC Nürnberg, FC St. Pauli, VfL Bochum and Eintracht Braunschweig.

#2469. Feyenoord second best to Betis as Isco is on the spot for CL win

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results

Feyenoord endured a frustrating evening in Spain as a penalty by Real Betis’s outstanding player, Isco, secured a 1-0 win for the La Liga side.

The Rotterdammers were second best for most of the game, but held out until the 59th minute, when Abde Ezzalzouli’s cross hit the arm of Jeremiah St. Juste in front of goal.

Isco, who was at the heart of Betis’s attacks all evening, grabbed the ball and gave Tjark Ernst no chance from the penalty spot.

Ernst had made good saves from former AZ Alkmaar striker Troy Parrott and Marc Batra to keep Feyenoord in the game in the first half, but Feyenoord had the best chance of the opening period when Gjivai Zechiël shot over the bar from close range.

The visitors had a claim for a penalty of their own turned down in the 68th minute when Givairo Read claimed he had been pushed by Ezzalzouli, but referee Simone Sozza waved the appeals away.

The result leaves Giovanni van Bronckhorst’s side in 26th place in the Champions League table, with Internazionale up next in De Kuip on November 3.

#2465. Bosz frustrated as Feyenoord hold PSV to 1-1 draw in Eindhoven

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results

See more DutchNews articles in your Google search results

Feyenoord preserved their four-point advantage over champions PSV after coming away with a point from Eindhoven thanks to an improved second-half performance.

PSV dominated the first half as they deployed a close-passing, tiki-taka style to stifle Feyenoord, but only had Guus Til’s well-taken volley after 20 minutes to show for it.

Ten minutes after the break Feyenoord equalised when Anis Hadj Moussa was given too much space to charge down the right flank and bend a shot inside the far post.

The Algerian had a good chance for a second towards the end, while PSV goalkeeper Matej Kovar had to be alert to keep out a header by Nacho Ferri from close range.

“We were by far the better team today and had the better chances,” said PSV coach Peter Bosz. “We started the second half badly and made a mistake, after which Hadj Moussa scored. And even then we could have won it.”

Ajax overtook PSV to close the gap at the top to three points with a hard-fought win at Sparta. Veteran striker Jens Toornstra scored for Sparta on his 500th Eredivisie appearance, but Abdellah Ouazane and Tolu Arokodare, the scorers against Atalanta in midweek, were on target again to claim the win for Ajax.

Twente moved up to fourth place as two late goals by Sondre Ørjasæter and Lucas Vennegoor of Hesselink earned a 2-0 win at AZ Alkmaar, who like Twente and PSV have 20 points.

Fortuna Sittard also snatched the points late on against Excelsior as Rodrigo Guth headed in a corner in injury time to keep the Limburg club in sixth place, two points further back.

At the other end of the table, the return of Adrie Koster as veteran coach brought no relief to Willem II, who crashed to a 6-1 home defeat to Cambuur.

The Tilburgers remain four points behind ADO Den Haag, who were unable to keep up the momentum of last week’s win against PSV as they lost 3-2 at home to Heerenveen.

Telstar lost by the same margin at Go Ahead Eagles, whose striker Søren Tengstedt netted twice in the first half to lead the Eredivisie scoring charts with eight goals.
